div.span:
Solid border: exists today. Dashed blue border: needed. Grey box: repository-local, or a tool that is not yet a skill. Solid arrow: hard dependency, the skill stops without it. Dashed arrow: reads, or composes.
1. A bundle depends only on bundles in the layers below it, and never on a repository above it. 2. A skill carries its method and its standards; where artefacts live is the repository's to declare. 3. The catalogue layer owns the definitions, the continuum; method bundles do not redefine them. 4. The scaffolding layer holds no layout of its own: it takes the house profile from the exemplar. 5. A solution keeps its architecture in a repository of its own (style A) or under docs/ of its own repository (style B); either way it is expressed with the continuum and checked by reconcile.
